title: Streetblend
description: Host-authoritative remote camouflage hide-and-seek using randomized public-domain paintings from Wikimedia Commons.

artwork.discovery: Runtime Commons API search across multiple painting genres and public-domain master painters, cached for 7 days.
artwork.randomization: Cryptographic Fisher-Yates shuffle; each painting is used once per deck before reshuffling, with immediate repeats avoided.

loading_behavior: Each round uses explicit HIDE_PREPARE and SEEK_PREPARE barriers. Hiding waits for the shared artwork to render on required seats; seeking waits for the final painted figure to render on all active Seeker seats. Timers start only after the active role screens acknowledge the authoritative phase.

hider_controls.resize_rotate: Visible interactive SIZE and ROTATE handles plus two-finger pinch/twist
hider_controls.view: Focus Player and Fit Artwork buttons
hider_controls.sampling: Tap to sample or long-press and slide for continuous magnified eyedropper sampling

seeker_controls: Quick tap guesses, drag pans, pinch zooms. Wrong-guess time penalties are configurable by the host.

controls.hider: Drag the player to place it; pinch/twist or use SIZE/ROTATE handles; pan/zoom the artwork; Sample automatically enters Paint; adjust brush size and opacity; Lock Hiding Spot when finished.
controls.seeker: Quick tap guesses; drag pans; pinch zooms. Search controls are not enabled until the authoritative Seek phase and timer are active.

figure.manipulation: Drag to place; pinch to resize and rotate.

eyedropper.footprint: Circular sampling area driven by the current brush-size slider.
eyedropper.aggregation: Mean RGB across all non-transparent source pixels inside the circular footprint.
eyedropper.loupe: Shows the sampled footprint and aggregated hex color.

ui_audit.artwork_bounds: Figure is clamped fully inside the artwork

multiplayer_sync.state_revision: Monotonic syncSeq plus round and phaseToken
multiplayer_sync.hide_prepare_barrier: All active seats must load/render the selected artwork before HIDE.
multiplayer_sync.seek_prepare_barrier: All active Seeker seats must load/render the final painted figure before SEEK.
multiplayer_sync.timer_start_barrier: Timed phase starts only after active role screens acknowledge the phase.
multiplayer_sync.critical_action_protocol: Lock and Guess use action IDs, host acknowledgements, retry, and duplicate suppression.
multiplayer_sync.heartbeat: Two-way pulse/pong repeats applied state acknowledgement and readiness.
multiplayer_sync.reconnect: Stable per-room player identity reclaims the same seat and receives a full recovery snapshot.
multiplayer_sync.disconnect_timer_behavior: Authoritative timer pauses during detected disconnect, heartbeat failure, host backgrounding, or offline state.
multiplayer_sync.reveal_barrier: Next round remains blocked until all active remote seats acknowledge Reveal.
multiplayer_sync.payload_strategy: Large figure and avatar assets are excluded from routine state snapshots.
